app.title: AI VS NAIWA
menu.subtitle: A dungeon adventure
menu.help: Explore rooms, defeat enemies and find weapons and exits. Survive three floors and defeat the final boss.
menu.controls:
Keyboard: WASD move · Mouse fire · Space dash · Q swap · E interact
Touch: Left stick move · Hold right wheel to fire, drag to aim · Action buttons below
Controller: Left stick move · Right stick aim · RT fire · B dash · Y swap · A interact · Start pause
hud.choose: Press 1 / 2 / 3, tap, or use the controller to choose and descend.
hint.start: Explore through doors · WASD / left stick move · Mouse / RT fire
hint.exit: Move to the center · E / A / Use to descend
hint.chest: E / A / Use near a weapon to equip · Q / Y to swap
hint.fight: Defeat all enemies to open doors · Space / B to dash
hint.clear: Room cleared · Walk near supplies to collect
save.unavailable: Storage unavailable: you can play, but progress cannot be saved
menu.replaceSave: Starting a new adventure will replace your current save. Continue?
save.updated: Game updated. Continue from this floor’s entrance.
save.invalid: Snapshot invalid. Continue from this floor’s entrance.
